endpoint_name_mapping.checkpoint_hash_note: File-level sha256 only (no tensor/safetensors deserialization performed). This is the identity check a future execution must match before trusting the loaded parent; matching the two weight-key names alone does not establish correct parent identity.

candidate_table_note: "provisionally_recognition_qualified" means M0 and both A-parents recognize the candidate above the 80/100 floor only -- it does not mean every gate is cleared; B's own direct single-edit suppression is untested for every candidate. golf ball and french horn were excluded by a documented SELECTION PREFERENCE (independence from the closed SD1.x line's own erasure/historical targets), not by a recognition failure and not by a statistical-independence proof -- see PROTOCOL.md section 3.

selected_pair.guide_B_source: released Flux/scripts/Double_Parachute_flux.sh single-edit example; reused verbatim for both DP and UCE

selection_rule_order: 1. implementation/guide support (released single-edit example providing a genuine guide value)
2. robust M0 and parent recognition (restrict to 100/100 on all three existing readings)
3. a documented preference (not a proof) for independence from the closed SD1.x line's own erasure/historical targets

meaningful_aggregate_deficit_threshold.definition: >=10 confirmed relapse witnesses out of 100 chain-saw cases
meaningful_aggregate_deficit_threshold.basis: round, interpretable, prospectively fixed number -- NOT derived from a significance or power calculation
meaningful_aggregate_deficit_threshold.existence_threshold: 1 confirmed witness is sufficient for an existence finding only, not a meaningful-aggregate-deficit finding
